commands.review_summary:
This PR removes the original-model prefix guard in the OpenAI embedding provider so non-native OpenAI embedding base URLs always send an `openai/`-qualified model, and adds regression tests for bare/proxy and native cases.

PR surface: Source +3, Tests +101. Total +104 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main and `v2026.6.11` normalize a bare OpenAI embedding model to a bare request model, and the current guard only re-adds `openai/` when the original model already had that prefix. I did not run a live Requesty or local endpoint request in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Maintainer review is needed to decide the non-native OpenAI endpoint contract, and the contributor must supply real behavior proof; there is no safe narrow automation repair without that decision.

target.title: fix(openai-embedding): re-add openai/ prefix for proxy providers even with bare model IDs
target.body:
## Problem

When using a proxy provider (e.g. Requesty) for embeddings with a **bare model ID** like `text-embedding-3-small` (no `openai/` prefix), the embedding request fails because:
1. `normalizeOpenAiModel` strips the `openai/` prefix
2. The guard `originalModel.startsWith("openai/")` prevents re-adding it for bare IDs
3. The proxy receives a bare model name it cannot route

## Fix

Remove the `originalModel.startsWith("openai/")` guard — for any non-native OpenAI base URL, always re-add the `openai/` prefix after normalization.

## Proof

17 tests passing (11 existing + 6 new):

| Test | Scenario |
|------|----------|
| adds openai/ prefix to bare model ID with proxy provider | Bare `text-embedding-3-small` → `openai/text-embedding-3-small` |
| sends qualified model in request body when bare model is used with proxy | The actual HTTP body gets the qualified name |
| normalizes already-prefixed model before re-adding prefix for proxy | `openai/text-embedding-3-small` → `openai/text-embedding-3-small` (no double prefix) |
| does not add openai/ prefix when bare model is used with native OpenAI | Native `api.openai.com` → no prefix |
| handles custom embedding models with proxy | `text-embedding-ada-002` → `openai/text-embedding-ada-002` |
| sends correct maxInputTokens with bare model and proxy | Token budget still computed from stripped name |

This is a **narrow, focused fix** — no unrelated features, no protocol changes, no new RPCs.
